description: GreyNoise Community lookup for an IPv4 address: whether it was seen mass-scanning the internet recently (noise), whether it is a known benign service (riot), its classification (benign, malicious, unknown), name and last-seen date. An address GreyNoise has not seen returns noise=false with a message; it is not a clean verdict. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
